mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in the unemployment rate above 5% signals weakening consumer demand and earnings pressure, which reduces S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when UNRATE > 5.0 (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) signals reduced household demand, which negatively impacts corporate earnings and S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of 3-month GDPC1 decline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the industrial production index (INDPRO) signals economic expansion and higher corporate earnings, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of 3-month INDPRO rise (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals a tightening monetary cycle that raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.5% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in payroll employment (PAYEMS) above 130,000 signals labor market strength and higher consumer spending, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods when PAYEMS > 130,000 (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in real retail sales (RSAFS) signals stronger consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of 3-month RSAFS rise (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the CPI inflation rate below 2.0% signals easing inflationary pressure, which reduces uncertainty and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods when CPIAUCSL < 202.0 (t-test p > 0.05).
